title: Signature Launch progress file (WF-SWARM)
description: One resumable progress file per launch, keyed by launch_id. Holds every unit from the approved launch plan, its state, and a terminal percentage. A stopped run resumes from this file: terminal units are skipped, and an active unit whose artifact exists is recovered as done without a duplicate build or a second charge.

launch_id.description: Plan launch_id. Also the progress-file and package key.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the approved plan this progress belongs to.

percent.description: Percentage of planned units that are terminal (done or dropped). Written on every save.

counts.description: Per-state counts written on every save.

units.description: Unit id -> state. Every page, email sequence, text set and automation from the plan.

waits_for.description: Unit ids that must be terminal before this unit starts.

charged.description: True once this unit has been charged (KIE spend). A terminal unit is never charged again.

artifact.description: Path or id of the built artifact. Existence of this path recovers a crashed unit as done.
